evidence_slice: The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham adopted its Local Plan 2037 on 18 September 2024. Policy SPP6 identifies site reference AD, Dagenham Leisure Park, as a housing and housing-led allocation with indicative net minimum capacity of 600 homes. The Greater London Authority Planning Local Plan Data dataset, updated 25 September 2026, publishes Barking and Dagenham planning policy spatial data and links to FeatureServer planning_local_plan_data_02. Its Site Allocations layer 6 is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer in EPSG:27700 with fields including sitereference and sitename and supports JSON, geoJSON and PBF queries. The available web transport did not return the AD feature's raw polygon bytes, so no geometry is fabricated; the exact official identifier AD is retained and authoritative polygon resolution and canonical parcel spatial join are delegated to local OpenCode.
binding_method: adopted exact local-plan allocation plus GLA polygon-capable FeatureServer Site Allocations layer; raw polygon query and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
